1. Introduction and Purpose
This document defines the customer service policies of Aura Retail Enterprises and provides the knowledge
base that every support agent - human or AI-powered - must use while helping customers. It ensures that all
customers receive accurate, consistent and respectful service regardless of the channel they use or the agent
they speak to.
1.1 Objectives

Provide one clear, approved source of truth for all customer-facing policies.

Reduce errors, contradictions and unauthorized promises made to customers.

Enable fast first-contact resolution with defined timelines and decision limits.



Enable fast first-contact resolution with defined timelines and decision limits.

Protect customer data and company reputation through clear privacy and escalation rules.

Serve as the primary knowledge source for the company's AI customer service agent.
1.2 Scope
These guidelines apply to all customer interactions via phone (UAN helpline), WhatsApp, live chat, e-mail, social
media (Facebook, Instagram) and the AI virtual assistant on the company website and mobile application. They
cover pre-sale queries, order tracking, delivery, payments, cancellations, returns, refunds, exchanges, warranty
and complaints.

Aura Retail Enterprises is a Pakistan-based multi-category retail company serving customers through its
e-commerce website, mobile app and partner retail outlets. The company offers consumer electronics, home
appliances, fashion and lifestyle products, furniture and everyday household goods, with delivery across Pakistan.

3. Agent Role, Tone and Communication Standards
Every agent represents the Aura Retail brand. Customers contact support when they are worried, confused or
dissatisfied, so the quality of the interaction is as important as the solution itself.
3.1 Core Service Principles

Be polite and respectful: always address customers as Sir, Madam or by name (for example, Ali Sahib,
Ayesha Madam).

Be clear and honest: never promise what the policy does not allow. If something is not possible, explain why
and offer an alternative.

Be empathetic: acknowledge the inconvenience before explaining the policy.



Be efficient: resolve the issue in the first contact whenever possible.

Be consistent: give the same answer that any other trained agent would give.

Take ownership: do not blame other departments, couriers or the customer.

3.4 Language and Writing Rules

Reply in the language the customer uses (Urdu, Roman Urdu or English).

Keep sentences short and avoid internal jargon such as "RTO" or "SLA breach" when speaking with
customers.

Never use sarcasm, slang or emojis excessively; one friendly emoji in chat is acceptable.

Always close the conversation with a summary of the next step and the expected timeline.

Never argue, raise your voice, or end the conversation abruptly.

Customer information is confidential. Before sharing any order detail or making any change to an order, the agent
must verify that the person contacting support is the genuine account or order holder.

4.2 Data Handling Rules

Never share a customer's address, phone number or order history with any third person.

Never ask customers for full card numbers, CVV, PIN or online banking passwords. Company staff will never
ask for these.

Never request an OTP from the customer for verification. If a customer receives a suspicious OTP request,
advise them not to share it.

Do not write customer data on paper, personal phones or personal messaging accounts.




Agent Note (AI Agents)
When using the order database, retrieve data only for the Order ID provided by the customer. Never list, export or
summarize multiple customers' records. If the contact number does not match the one on the order, do not reveal
any order details and politely request correct information.
4.3 Suspected Fraud Indicators

Customer requests delivery to a different address immediately after the order is shipped.


5. Order Management Policy
Orders are placed through the website, mobile app or by phone and are recorded in the order database with a
unique Order ID in the format ORD-2026-XXXX. The order database contains: Order ID, Customer Name,
Contact Number, Product, Order Date, Shipping Address and Status.

are estimates calculated in working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the date of

6.3 Delivery Attempts and Failed Delivery

The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts on consecutive working days.

If the customer is unreachable after 3 attempts, the parcel is returned to the warehouse. Prepaid orders are
refunded after deducting shipping charges; COD orders are cancelled.

Customers may request re-delivery or pickup from the nearest courier office by contacting support.

Deliveries are made only to the address on the order. A different person may receive the parcel if the customer
authorizes them.

7.2 Payment Rules

Prices are displayed in PKR and include applicable taxes (GST) unless otherwise stated.

Orders paid by bank transfer must include the Order ID as payment reference.

If a payment is deducted but the order is not confirmed, the amount is automatically reversed within 3 - 7
working days. Agents should ask for a screenshot or transaction ID to trace it faster.

Company staff will never ask customers to pay into a personal account or send money through an unofficial
link.
7.3 Promotions and Discount Vouchers

Only one voucher can be used per order and vouchers cannot be combined with other offers unless stated.


7.3 Promotions and Discount Vouchers

Only one voucher can be used per order and vouchers cannot be combined with other offers unless stated.

Vouchers are non-transferable and have no cash value.

If an order is cancelled, a used voucher is re-issued once, valid for 7 days, at the company's discretion.

Agents cannot create or approve discounts. Pricing disputes must be escalated to the supervisor.

14. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Use the answers below as approved responses. Adapt the wording to the customer's language and situation but
do not change the facts, numbers or timelines.
Q1. How long does delivery take?
 A: Zone A cities take 2 - 4 working days, Zone B 4 - 6 working days and Zone C 6 - 9 working days from
dispatch. Express delivery (1 - 3 working days) is available in Zones A and B.

Q2. Is delivery free?
 A: Delivery is free for orders of PKR 5,000 and above in Zones A and B. Below this amount, charges are PKR
200 - 400 depending on the zone.
Q3. Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
 A: Yes, COD is available for orders up to PKR 150,000 with a PKR 100 handling fee.
Q4. Can I pay in installments?
 A: Yes, selected bank credit cards offer 3, 6 and 12-month plans on orders above PKR 20,000, subject to bank
approval.
Q5. How can I track my order?
 A: Share your Order ID and registered mobile number with support, or use the tracking link sent by SMS or
WhatsApp after dispatch.
Q6. Can I change my shipping address?

WhatsApp after dispatch.
Q6. Can I change my shipping address?
 A: Yes, only while the order is Pending or Processing. After dispatch, a courier request can be raised but is not
guaranteed.
Q7. Can I cancel my order?
 A: Yes, free of charge while the order is Pending or Processing. After dispatch, you may refuse delivery.
Q8. What is the return period?
 A: 7 days from the date of delivery for eligible products in unused condition with original packaging.
Q9. Which items cannot be returned?
 A: Innerwear, hygiene items, opened earphones, grocery packs, clearance and customized items, and
products damaged by misuse.
Q10. Who pays the return shipping?
 A: Aura Retail pays when the item is wrong, damaged or defective. For change-of-mind returns, a PKR 250
pickup fee may apply.

A: Aura Retail pays when the item is wrong, damaged or defective. For change-of-mind returns, a PKR 250
pickup fee may apply.
Q11. How long does a refund take?
 A: Wallets 3 - 5 days, cards 7 - 10 days, bank transfer or COD refunds 5 - 7 working days after the return is
approved.
Q12. Why was my refund deducted?
 A: Shipping and COD fees are non-refundable on change-of-mind returns. Full refunds are given for company
errors.
Q13. I received a wrong item. What should I do?
 A: Contact support within 48 hours with photos and your Order ID. We will arrange a free pickup and send the
correct item.
Q14. My product stopped working after 2 months. Is it covered?
 A: Yes, if covered under the manufacturer warranty. Please visit the authorized service centre with your

A: Yes, if covered under the manufacturer warranty. Please visit the authorized service centre with your
invoice; our team can guide you.
Q15. Do you provide warranty on mobiles?
 A: Yes, mobiles carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty, excluding physical or water damage.
Q16. My payment was deducted but the order is not confirmed.
 A: Please share the transaction ID or screenshot. Failed transactions are reversed automatically in 3 - 7
working days.
Q17. Can I use two discount vouchers together?
 A: No, only one voucher is allowed per order unless the promotion states otherwise.
Q18. What if I am not available at delivery time?
 A: The courier makes up to 3 attempts. You can also ask support to reschedule or nominate another receiver.

Q19. Is it safe to share my card details with an agent?
 A: No. Our staff will never ask for card numbers, PIN, CVV or OTP. Please report such requests immediately.
Q20. How do I make a complaint?
 A: Contact support through phone, WhatsApp, e-mail or chat. You will receive a ticket number and a resolution
timeline.
Q21. What are your support hours?
 A: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM and Sunday 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM (PKT).
Q22. Do you deliver to remote areas?
 A: Yes, Zone C areas are served within 6 - 9 working days. Express delivery is not available there.
Q23. Can I get a duplicate invoice?

A: Yes, Zone C areas are served within 6 - 9 working days. Express delivery is not available there.
Q23. Can I get a duplicate invoice?
 A: Yes. After verification, an invoice copy can be e-mailed to the registered address within 24 hours.
Q24. Will I get a refund if I refuse the parcel at the door?
 A: Prepaid orders are refunded after the parcel returns to our warehouse, minus the shipping fee. COD orders
have no charge.
